title: Quercetagitrin targets EIF3D to activate NCOA4-mediated ferritinophagy-dependent ferroptosis for the treatment of non-small cell lung cancer.
authors: Tang, Xinglinzi; Wu, Feiyan; Rao, Huijuan; Luo, Xinyi; Zhang, Guixing; Lai, Xin; Li, Caizhi; Fang, Jiansong; Li, Hang
journal: Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究槲皮万寿菊素靶向EIF3D激活铁蛋白自噬依赖性铁死亡治疗肺癌，虽含分子动力学模拟，但核心是药物-蛋白靶点与细胞死亡通路，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合体系，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) is the predominant subtype of lung cancer. Although traditional treatment methods such as surgery, chemotherapy, and radiotherapy can extend patient survival to some extent, they still present significant challenges due to their limited efficacy and substantial side effects. Ferroptosis, a form of iron-dependent programmed cell death, has been shown to exhibit considerable potential in the treatment of NSCLC. However, the molecular mechanisms underlying ferroptosis and how to safely and effectively induce it remain to be fully explored. This study aims to investigate the mechanism by which the natural flavonoid compound Quercetagitrin (Que) regulates the ferritinophagy-ferroptosis pathway to suppress NSCLC and to identify its molecular targets. METHODS: This study evaluated the selective toxicity of Que against NSCLC cells (A549, PC9) and normal lung epithelial cells (BEAS-2B) using in vitro assays, including CCK-8, colony formation, and flow cytometry. Key pathways related to ferritinophagy and ferroptosis were identified through transcriptomic analysis and KEGG pathway analysis. Fluorescence imaging, Western blot (WB) and BODIPY C11 staining were used to assess the levels of ferritinophagy and ferroptosis in cells. Limited proteolysis-mass spectrometry (LiP-MS) and molecular dynamics simulations were employed to identify the direct targets of Que. Gene knockdown and overexpression experiments were conducted to verify that Que targets eukaryotic translation initiation factor 3 subunit D (EIF3D) and regulates the activation of nuclear receptor coactivator 4 (NCOA4) -mediated ferritinophagy. In vivo experiments using xenograft mouse models assessed the antitumor effect and safety of Que. RESULTS: Que selectively inhibited the proliferation and colony formation of NSCLC cells while showing minimal toxicity to normal lung epithelial cells. It promoted the release of Fe(2)(+) and lipid peroxidation by activating the NCOA4-dependent ferritinophagy pathway, while simultaneously inhibiting the expression of ferroptosis markers such as glutathione peroxidase 4 (GPX4). LiP-MS and molecular dynamics simulations confirmed EIF3D as a direct target of Que. Knockdown of EIF3D mimicked the antitumor effect of Que, whereas overexpression of EIF3D diminished its antitumor effect. In vivo, Que significantly inhibited tumor growth without observable toxicity, accompanied by upregulation of NCOA4 and LC3 II, and downregulation of EIF3D and GPX4. CONCLUSION: Que exerts significant antitumor effects in NSCLC by targeting EIF3D to activate NCOA4-mediated ferritinophagy and ferroptosis. This study reveals a novel mechanism involving the EIF3D-NCOA4 axis in the regulation of ferritinophagy-dependent ferroptosis, providing a potential therapeutic strategy for the treatment of NSCLC.
abstract_zh: 背景：非小细胞肺癌（NSCLC）是肺癌的主要亚型。尽管手术、化疗和放疗等传统治疗方法能在一定程度上延长患者生存期，但由于疗效有限且副作用显著，仍面临重大挑战。铁死亡（ferroptosis）作为一种铁依赖性程序性细胞死亡形式，已被证实在NSCLC治疗中具有相当大的潜力。然而，铁死亡的分子机制以及如何安全有效地诱导铁死亡仍有待充分探索。本研究旨在探讨天然黄酮类化合物Quercetagitrin（Que）调控铁蛋白自噬-铁死亡通路以抑制NSCLC的机制，并鉴定其分子靶点。方法：本研究通过体外实验，包括CCK-8、集落形成和流式细胞术，评估了Que对NSCLC细胞（A549、PC9）和正常肺上皮细胞（BEAS-2B）的选择性毒性。通过转录组分析和KEGG通路分析，鉴定了与铁蛋白自噬和铁死亡相关的关键通路。采用荧光成像、Western blot（WB）和BODIPY C11染色评估细胞中铁蛋白自噬和铁死亡的水平。使用有限蛋白水解-质谱联用（LiP-MS）和分子动力学模拟鉴定Que的直接靶点。通过基因敲低和过表达实验，验证Que靶向真核翻译起始因子3亚基D（EIF3D）并调控核受体共激活因子4（NCOA4）介导的铁蛋白自噬的激活。使用异种移植小鼠模型的体内实验评估了Que的抗肿瘤效果和安全性。结果：Que选择性抑制NSCLC细胞的增殖和集落形成，同时对正常肺上皮细胞表现出极低的毒性。它通过激活NCOA4依赖性铁蛋白自噬通路促进Fe(2)(+)释放和脂质过氧化，同时抑制谷胱甘肽过氧化物酶4（GPX4）等铁死亡标志物的表达。LiP-MS和分子动力学模拟确认EIF3D为Que的直接靶点。EIF3D敲低模拟了Que的抗肿瘤效果，而EIF3D过表达则削弱了其抗肿瘤效果。在体内，Que显著抑制肿瘤生长且未观察到明显毒性，伴随NCOA4和LC3 II的上调，以及EIF3D和GPX4的下调。结论：Que通过靶向EIF3D激活NCOA4介导的铁蛋白自噬和铁死亡，在NSCLC中发挥显著的抗肿瘤作用。本研究揭示了EIF3D-NCOA4轴在调控铁蛋白自噬依赖性铁死亡中的新机制，为NSCLC治疗提供了潜在的治疗策略。
